name: shizsun0609tw/SoftBodySimulation
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; not full audit/build/benchmark
finding: Velocity-first Euler is explicit in the viewed update. ImplicitEuler evaluates forces on a copy of current cube then advances; no nonlinear future-state solve appears in the selected method. Integrator names need equation-level verification.

name: Hykudoru/Softbody-Physics-Simulation
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; not full audit/build/benchmark
finding: Spring holds a rest vector offset rather than rest scalar length; each spring applies velocity damping to endpoints, particle adds velocity directly to position. No dt parameter in selected update; rotation invariance and valence/frame dependence require tests.

name: amaury-aubel/PBD-2d-sim-gpu
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; not full audit/build/benchmark
finding: Viewed CPU contact branch applies equal/opposite positional overlap corrections and tangential displacement scaling. Does not prove GPU path equivalence or Coulomb friction/CCD.

name: JohannHotzel/UnitySimplePhysics
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; not full audit/build/benchmark
finding: Surface skinned from up to four rigid particle transforms using current*rest.inverse and stored weights, then mesh bounds/normals refreshed. Earlier joint setup has linear/angular drives and force limits; skinning is a render embedding, not volumetric tissue elasticity.

name: wlgys8/PBDClothLearn
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; not full audit/build/benchmark
finding: Unity jobs generate distance corrections with separate compression/stretch coefficients; bending uses normal/area gradients and inverse masses. Shared correction accumulation requires caller scheduling audit; no race asserted from fragment alone.

name: Jenny19880324/XPBD
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; not full audit/build/benchmark
finding: Distance XPBD iterates with accumulated lambda, alpha=1/(ym*h²), fixed-node update exclusions and recomputed velocity. Static rest-length vector and degenerate edge normalization need independent multi-mesh/zero-length tests.

name: WindQAQ/MPM
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; not full audit/build/benchmark
finding: CUDA/Thrust P2G computes force from particle energy derivative, scatters mass/momentum/force through atomicAdd and ignores out-of-grid neighbor nodes. Requires boundary mass/momentum conservation checks, not assumed from kernel.

name: Elias-Gu/MPM2D
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; not full audit/build/benchmark
finding: OpenMP P2G calls particle constitutive model then scatters weighted mass/APIC momentum/force with per-component atomics. Constitutive implementation remains to inspect; 2D transfer is not an organ profile.

name: jspdown/cloth
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; not full audit/build/benchmark
finding: WGSL uses color ranges and in-place distance corrections with compliance/dt²; no accumulated lambda buffer in viewed kernel. Concurrent safety depends on disjoint vertices inside each color; buffers encode affected particle IDs as f32.

name: bennybroseph/Unity-Physics
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; not full audit/build/benchmark
finding: Spring/damper updates endpoint forces, initial rest length is 0.8 of distance, tear threshold marks linked triangles. Zero distance normalization unguarded in selected method; tearing criterion is geometric, not calibrated tissue damage.
